case_title: OPORTUN, INC. VS. LIVAIR DE SILVA NOGUEIRA

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF MAR-19-2019 - JOSEFINA FLORES AS LEGAL COLLECTIONS SPECIALIST PRESENT FOR PLAINTIFF OPORTUN INC., WAS PLACED UNDER OATH AND TESTIFIED. NO APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT. AFTER HEARING THE EVIDENCE PRESENTED, THE COURT TAKES THIS MATTER UNDER SUBMISSION. NO EXHIBIT RETAINED BY THE COURT. JUDGE JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK S. RAVINANTAPRICHA. NOT REPORTED.
